newsitem.title: FRANCE: French wheat bids - 25,000 T seen at lowest refund.
newsitem.headline: French wheat bids - 25,000 T seen at lowest refund.

text.p: French wheat bids on Thursday started with 25,000 tonnes sought at the lowest refund level of 8.48 Ecus per tonne, implying the highest world price, grain traders said.
The lowest refund of 8.48 Ecus per tonne equates to a world price of $159-$160 per tonne, they said.
In France grain traders bid to export a total of 521,200 tonnes of EU soft wheat at refunds ranging from 8.48 to 16.39 Ecus per tonne, national grain office ONIC reported earlier.
In other bids, exporters sought a cumulative total of 133,000 tonnes up to a refund of 10.50 Ecus, they said.
The total rose to 183,000 tonnes for a maximum refund of 11.50 Ecus, 268,000 tonnes for 12.00 Ecus, 332,000 tonnes for 12.50 Ecus and 342,000 for up to 13 Ecus.
